title: ios-scan-fixture
responsibility: Owns the ios-scan-fixture build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: holds.product
inputs.description: Filesystem path to a product tree passed to `contents`. It matters when checking the built fixture, and the files returned by `contents` must be readable.

inputs.name: holds.words
inputs.description: Literal substring to search for in each product file. The check uses `includes`, so the value is not treated as a regular expression or a whole-file comparison.

outputs.name: scanFixtureProduct
outputs.description: Absolute destination path for `App.app` under `desktopRoot/.cache/ios/scan-fixture`. It names the test-only product built with the synthetic scanner.

outputs.name: holds
outputs.description: Whether at least one file returned by `contents(product)` includes the requested substring. It is false when no scanned file matches.

outputs.name: buildScanFixture
outputs.description: Resolved path string returned by `changedCopy` after the Debug simulator product passes the synthetic-scanner marker check. The product is built from an isolated source copy that allows only the camera scanner file to differ.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An `Error` is thrown if the isolated source differs in anything other than exactly the camera scanner replacement, or if the built product lacks `scanMarker`. Failures from the uncaught build, file-read, and copy steps also propagate.
